correctness.rationale: The exact two-sided Poisson gap representation gives the unique Gaussian variance mixture. Its finite-s scaled moment product is exact. Riemann sums converge with derivatives locally within the natural mgf ball to half a dilogarithm. Exponential tightness and explicit interior tilts with vanishing covariance prove the full good LDP, without reliance on convergence at the mgf boundary. Radial Legendre calculus yields the unique y-parametrization, orthant rate and strict concavity. The embedded checker independently reproduced the pressure, Legendre optimization and boundary laws.

value.rationale: The stationary gas becomes independent Gaussian on fixed spatial scales, yet its joint rare-excursion rate remains strictly smaller under a common reset clock than under independent clocks. The good LDP gives the complete finite-dimensional radial rate and a closed dilogarithmic crossover, demonstrating a substantive rare-event boundary to the common Gaussian diffusion approximation; this is not an arbitrary invariant or a routine fixed-parameter specialization.
